answers.answer: Contoso lists $1,200 per team per month on a 12-month term. Relaymark charges per seat.
Most handoff tools offer a native CRM connector. Ask which CRM setups the vendor tests against.
Contoso sells team plans. Relaymark sells seat plans, and its published setup time is 6 to 8 weeks.
Handoff software prices vary. Some vendors charge per seat and some charge per team. Ask for a written quote.
Contoso connects to HubSpot, Salesforce, and Pipedrive through native connectors.
